contract: A23-109 server (contract with 게임성 개발 1, Config.QuickSlots read only): data.QuickSlots = "<i1>,<i2>,<i3>" (Config.QuickSlots.Items keys HP / MP, "" = empty; additive, Version 3). A brand-new save gets Config.QuickSlots.Default (empty, 검수 10/10) from DataService; a stored save without the field (from before the quick slots) gets HP, MP, empty once; a broken value (not text, > 120 chars) = the Default; cleaned and saved at PlayerReady (unknown items and repeats empty, extra parts dropped). The owner's attribute QuickSlots = the same text, set at PlayerReady and after every accepted change; the client's QuickSlots.Parse reads it the same. c->s SetQuickSlot(slot 1..3 integer, item key | ""): the item already in another slot swaps with this slot's; the same item on its own slot / emptying an empty slot = no change; bad or extra args, not ready, left, no data, faster than Config.RateLimits.SetQuickSlot (0.2 s): nothing, no notice. QuickSlotService.Changed(player, slots) after every accepted change; an item put into a slot (also a swap) calls S.StoryQuestService.Event(player, "QuickSlotSet", { Slot, Kind }) when it exists (pcall; emptying, no change and refused calls: nothing). Get(player); Parse(value). A slot press stays the UsePotion remote (VitalsService, unchanged).
